name: content-to-pdf
description: Paste raw content, get a branded use case PDF. Pluggable Claude/OpenAI/Gemini extraction.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,magenta "pnpm --filter backend dev" "pnpm --filter frontend dev"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter backend build && pnpm --filter frontend build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter backend typecheck && pnpm --filter frontend typecheck
scripts.install:browsers: pnpm --filter backend exec playwright install chromium
